card: A failed core call still commits its beat: picks, bits and room events burn
deviations_from_card: Mechanism: BeatTxn is a snapshot of the Orchestrator taken after screen() and before plan() (Orchestrator/RoomWatch/Agenda derive Clone), not a hand-listed delta of each consumption; rollback restores it and re-carries the picks (carry_next entries with original since/expires, safety picks from carried_in or fresh). This covers every staged consumption incl. the agenda (pick-ups, request loops) that landed in e523f3b after the card, with no room.requeue needed (the restored RoomWatch re-detects the closed vote). One commit pair: test (red) then feat; the card's three-commit split collapsed to one feat commit. Coupled files outside the write set: orchestrate/agenda.rs (one-token #[derive(Clone)]) and tests.rs (the existing a_beat_is_one_turn_record_whether_the_engine_answered_or_not pinned the old contract that a failed beat records its picks as a turn; renamed to a_failed_beat_is_no_turn_record_and_the_beat_that_answers_its_picks_is_one and asserts one turn). moderation.rs untouched (only the note_answered call site moved, in lib.rs). Case 3 uses the sample prep's 6-line cold open (lines 1-2/6), not a 4-line one. Also restores Brain.fresh_bit on failure.
notes: Premise re-verified at HEAD after e523f3b and f2e09d2: note_answered and orch.commit still ran before call_core; the fleet-failure branch still recorded the turn and restored nothing. Whole-tree gates red in the shared checkout only on sibling in-flight files (shadowrunr-sim runner.rs/transcript.rs LiveSink/with_sink, shadowrunr-daemon e2e/events.rs fmt + live_sim_events_arrive_before_the_engine_answers + a LiveSink doctest), re-run once after a wait, still only there; the same gates are green on a scratch copy of HEAD plus this change (21 test binaries ok, sim 130 ok). Residual: a memory-store error (`?`) between commit and the core call still returns without rollback (not a core-call failure; out of card scope). The snapshot clones answered/seen_viewers sets per voiced beat (O(stream ids), negligible at 5 s beats).
